layman_headline: Market fear is at extreme levels — patience beats impulse right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is gripped by extreme fear with a score of 25 out of 100 and worsening. While Bitcoin is holding around $63,700 with a small bounce, altcoins are getting hammered — Bitcoin dominance at 56.4% means money is flowing away from smaller coins. There are a few interesting setups forming, particularly LDO after a sharp 22% weekly drop, but the overall environment is hostile for new entries. The smart move is to wait for fear to stabilize or reverse before committing capital.
layman_action: Stay in cash for now. The market is panicking and conditions are too uncertain to justify opening new positions. Watch for fear to bottom out and stabilize — that's when the real opportunities emerge.
expert_reasoning: Per my validated rules, when Fear & Greed is at 25 (right at the threshold), the short-term outlook is genuinely ambiguous and the safest call is HOLD. BTC dominance at 56.4% is actively hostile to altcoin positions. LDO is the most compelling candidate with a 22% weekly drawdown and approaching key support at $0.30, but the chart bias is neutral-to-negative (-0.10), it's in a downtrend, and price is below all major MAs. ZRO has an oversold RSI at 30 (a historically reliable signal per my credibility data), but its bearish chart bias of -0.70 and poor risk/reward of 1.31x make it a low-quality setup. BTW and PUMP have already run significantly and carry elevated correction risk. No funding rate data is available for any candidate, which removes a key confirmation tool.

BTC dominance at 56.4% means capital rotation is actively moving away from altcoins into Bitcoin
US-Japan yen intervention creating macro uncertainty that could trigger broader risk-off liquidations across crypto
watch_list: Fear & Greed Index — watch for stabilization above 30 as a signal the worst panic is passing
LDO price action at $0.30 support — a strong bounce with volume would confirm the mean-reversion thesis
BTC price action around $64,000 resistance — rejection here could trigger another leg down in alts
market_context: Extreme Fear (25/100, worsening) with BTC holding near $63,700 but altcoins broadly weak. High BTC dominance at 56.4% and macro headwinds from potential US-Japan yen intervention create a hostile environment for new altcoin entries.
context_banner: Extreme fear at the 25 threshold demands patience — the best swing trades emerge after panic stabilizes, not during it.
